sources.shortCitation: GND authority record for Paul Mann, composer
sources.fullCitation: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek, GND 133442284, “Mann, Paul”, composer, born 1910 in Vienna and died 27 May 1983 in New York. Variant forms: Wechselmann, Paul; Mawersky, Paul Stephan; Bachinger, Alois; Marois, Jean; and Walden, Peter. Linked records include BnF ark:/12148/cb14768347k, LCNAF nb2003055670, VIAF 3662538 and Wikidata Q31202678. Accessed 1 August 2026.
sources.researchNote: The Library of Congress heading reads “Mann, Paul, 1910-1983” and cites the 1944 sheet “Tell me I'm the only one you care for”. The day and month of birth are contested: the German Wikipedia article gives 3 September 1910 while the GND gives 3 October 1910; both agree on the year and on the death date, 27 May 1983.
